Sunnyvale car accident leaves one dead

Driver crashes into light pole Monday morning; vehicle, traffic signs damaged
Jamie Watt, La Voz Staff
November 10, 2026
Gallery | 3 Photos
Jamie Watt
Traffic cones sit on the rubble remaining in the center divider of El Camino Real on Nov. 10. Car fluids from the Nov. 9 crash can still be seen on the road where the car collided.

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:00
Instaread

A woman was pronounced dead after crashing her vehicle into a light pole on El Camino Real and Sunnyvale-Saratoga Road on Monday, Nov. 9.

The single-vehicle accident occurred at 9:58 a.m. on the eastbound lanes of El Camino Real with significant damage to the vehicle, the light pole and traffic signs just feet away from the collision site.

“Upon arrival, officers provided medical attention to the driver, but unfortunately they were pronounced deceased at the scene,” Sunnyvale Department of Public Safety Media and Engagement Manager Paige Johnson said.

As the incident remains under investigation, the identity and cause of the accident are currently unknown.

“Based on preliminary findings, drugs and alcohol don’t seem to have been a factor in the collision,” Johnson said.

S and S Tire and Auto Repair Manager Sam Reiisi said public safety officers blocked off the road for several hours; the repair shop sits about 300 yards down from the incident site.

“That part of El Camino Real was closed off for the majority, if not the entirety of the day,” Reiisi said. “There was a lot of traffic here.”

Jamie Watt, Sports Editor
Jamie watt is a journalism major with a overarching interest in sports, music and arts. This is her fourth quarter with La Voz, having explored and worked in several areas of journalism. Watt hopes to continue improving her leadership skills as well as break further into sports photography.
